blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—University of the Philippines got a huge shot in the arm from its bench in a big win over rival La Salle in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. Most especially, the Fighting Maroons drew a much-needed spark from newcomer Elliot Dimaculangan, who made his debut in the 80-76 victory on Sunday, snapping a two-game skid. According to UP coach Goldwin Monteverde, Dimaculangan’s debut was a long time coming after the Filipino-Canadian guard was forced to miss the team’s first several games due to an injury.
